svg.title: OneNAND flash layout
svg.desc: Stack of the OneNAND flash regions from block 0 to block 0x1ff, showing what each holds and which update file rewrites it.
svg.text: never: no official package ships type 1
512 B reflector header, spare tag INF
table scanned in 1..0xb (tag REP), pool from 0xc down
captured block 1 is erased: no block remapped
Unused part of the main window
13 blocks, all 0xFF on the main camera
checked by the Monitor before it loads main
calibration and tone words; qrflect3 never touches it
no reader or writer found (bounded), erased
RAM settings 0x1b000 saved on power-off; destination untraced
written at runtime; kept by updates
Not to scale. Flash offset = block x 0x10000. Blocks 0x66 and up were not captured from the main camera.
